title: América Latina y la crisis
goal: Read how collapsing commodity demand and drying-up foreign lending proved the export model's structural vulnerability true, and why Chile was among the hardest-hit countries in the world.

items: Explain what Latin America discovered as the U.S. crisis spread.
State how much coffee prices fell between 1929 and 1932.
Explain what several governments were forced to do once foreign lending stopped.
Describe why Chile was hit so hard by the crisis.
Use tan pronto como to stress how immediately one event followed another.
